newsitem.title: USA: Edison "on plan" to emerge from Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Edison "on plan" to emerge from Chapter 11.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said it is "on plan" to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in spring 1997.
"We are encouraged by the initial results of the companywide initiatives," said chief executive Alan Miller. "However, we're still in the middle of our restructuring phase."
He said the company is restructuring in three phases.
"The third and final phase, anticipated to occur in spring 1997, will be to emerge from Chapter 11," he said.
The retailer filed to reorganize under Chapter 11 of the bankruptcy code in November.
